releaseNotes: Reader Pro 0.10.2 adds previous/next page controls and current page indicator in fullscreen mode
Marker opacity is adjustable from 1/10 to 10/10 and persists locally
Added dedicated eraser tool for removing individual annotation strokes
BOOX stylus eraser/backside PointerEvent support is enabled where Android WebView exposes the pen eraser button
Fit Page, Fit Width, 100 percent, manual zoom, pen/marker colors and thickness remain available
Existing Work Pro, Linear foundation and LuMa Sync features remain available
